instruction: Look at freecad_task-15_input.step in FreeCAD. For this workflow, launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad` and open `freecad_task-15_input.step` there. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body and use feature or placement tools for the requested edits. The input contains two intersecting perpendicular solid cylindrical members forming a T-junction. Fuse the two members into one solid. Add one coaxial solid circular flange to the X-axis member end at X=0 and one to the Y-axis member end at Y=-70. Each flange must have outside diameter 50 mm and thickness 8 mm, extending outward to X=-8 and Y=-78 respectively. Do not add bores. Export the fused double-flanged T-junction as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-15_output.step.
